title: Lite-Solo exact generation phase machine request index

requestPath.description: Campaign-local work/phase-NN/execution-requests/ request JSON bound to campaign ID, generation-derived assignment ID and source digest; previous-generation requests are invalid.

description: One exact campaign generation and phase per request index. Every referenced V7 request must have assignmentId phase-NN-g<first24 of SHA256(JSON.stringify(campaignGenerationId))>-c<first24 of SHA256(JSON.stringify(candidateKey))>. Phase finalization consumes already persisted machine results; it never executes tests.
